patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gusto and HiBob share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Gusto only if your buying job matches “US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Pre” rather than HiBob's shape. Choose HiBob only if your buying job matches “Culture-forward mid-market HRIS (Bob Core + modules) — custom PEPM quote; no published sea” rather than Gusto's shape. Workflow advantage: Gusto leans payroll-benefits; HiBob leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gusto and HiBob share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gusto is US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Premium $180 + $22.; HiBob is Culture-forward mid-market HRIS (Bob Core + modules) — custom PEPM quote; no published seat dollars; AI Companion included in Core..
- Company-size focus: Gusto (micro, small-business) vs HiBob (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gusto-leaning payroll-benefits vs HiBob-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Gusto — Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; HiBob — No published PEPM — implementation and modules dominate TCO.

Limitations — Gusto: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first; HiBob: No published PEPM — implementation and modules dominate TCO; No free plan or self-serve trial.

Poor-fit cases: Gusto is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus · HiBob is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published PEPM — implementation and modules dominate TCO · Avoid Gusto if you actually need HiBob's motion (Culture-forward mid-market HRIS (Bob Core + modules) — custom PEPM quote; no pub)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
